summary: In January 2018, two people were arrested in Panipat, Haryana for the gang rape involving a minor. The charges also include murder, kidnapping, abduction, procuring a minor and destroying evidence. A weapon was used or a threat was made. Police have filed a chargesheet. The accused were convicted. An appeal against the verdict has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Gang rape involving a minor — Panipat (2018) — appeal pending
